jobs.occupation: Technician (f/m/d) - Energy Conversion & Hydrogen Technologies - JOB ID: 272028
jobs.description:
1 Technician (f/m/d) - Energy Conversion & Hydrogen Technologies - JOB ID: 272028 CENTER FOR ENERGY
 * You are responsible for the maintenance and operation of our experimental infrastructure, including physical vapor deposition (PVD) systems, materials characterization equipment (e.g. XRD, SEM, electrochemical workstations), and electrolyzer test stands - ensuring reliable and safe operation.
 * You actively support the design and build-up of new experimental test stands, working closely with scientists and engineers to translate research requirements into functional laboratory setups.
 * You develop and maintain Python-based measurement and automation software, including data acquisition routines, instrument control interfaces, and data processing scripts that support the team's experimental workflows.
 * You manage the procurement process for laboratory consumables, materials, and technical components - including preparation of orders, tracking of deliveries, and maintaining an organized inventory of laboratory supplies.
 * You coordinate with external suppliers and service providers for equipment repairs, calibrations, and upgrades, and maintain up-to-date technical documentation for all systems under your responsibility.
 * You contribute to a safe and well-organized laboratory environment by adhering to safety regulations, performing routine checks, and supporting the introduction of new team members into laboratory procedures.
 * You work independently and proactively, identifying and resolving technical issues across a broad range of systems, bridging the gap between hands-on hardware work and software-based solutions.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:
 * Completed technical degree (HTL, Fachhochschule, or equivalent) in mechatronics, electrical engineering or a comparable field; a university degree in a relevant discipline is equally welcome.
 * Practical experience in building, operating and maintaining laboratory or industrial equipment is an advantage
 * Experience in design including practical skills with CAD software and 3D-printing, manufacturing and mechanical engineering
 * Solid Python programming skills, with experience in measurement automation, instrument control, microcontrollers, data acquisition, or scientific data processing; familiarity with common libraries (NumPy, Matplotlib, pandas) is an advantage
 * Basic understanding of electrochemical processes, thin-film technologies, or materials characterization methods is a plus, but enthusiasm and willingness to learn are equally valued
 * Structured, reliable, and independent working style combined with a hands-on mentality and genuine enjoyment of troubleshooting complex technical systems
 * Strong team orientation and good communication skills; you enjoy working in an international and interdisciplinary research environment
 * Very good command of English; German language skills are an advantage for day-to-day communication

 What to expect: 
The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 46.592,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions, individual training and career opportunities.

 At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.

jobs.description:
Developing solutions for the green future of the metal industry?

Primetals Technologies is a global plant manufacturer and service partner to the metals industry and offers a wide range of career opportunities. We are pioneers, in the heart of Linz, with an extraordinary passion to lead the metals industry towards decarbonization and digitalization, ... 1 Project Manager for ECO Solutions and Converter Steelmaking (m/f/*) 

WHAT ARE MY RESPONSIBILITIES?

Our department manages the execution of projects in the fields of ECO Solutions and Converter Steelmaking. We deliver excellent project management and take full ownership of projects - from contract award to project completion - with a strong focus on maximizing profitability and customer satisfaction. Our ECO Solutions portfolio provides technologies and services to reduce emissions across iron and steel production while improving energy efficiency. In Converter Steelmaking, we cover LD (BOF) and AOD converter plants, as well as the innovative SMELTER technology for significantly lower carbon emissions. As sustainable steel production becomes increasingly important, we are strengthening our team I&S PM ECO&CS (ECO Solutions & Converter Steelmaking) with a Project Manager to lead these projects with the following tasks:

 * You have full responsibility for the successful implementation of your projects.
 * You manage the project within the defined financial, quality and schedule targets.
 * You identify additional opportunities within ongoing projects. You negotiate with stakeholders on change requests and incorporate them into contracts.
 * You manage the project risks by identifying and assessing all risk factors using available risk assessment tools.
 * You continuously monitor the project status, identify discrepancies at an early stage, and initiate mitigation measures where necessary.
 * You work closely with your team, define targets, and delegate responsibilities and authority.
 * You ensure compliance with valid regulations, rules and standards.
 * You ensure efficient communication with all relevant stakeholders.
 * You drive the project closure and ensure that all relevant information is filed and available for future projects.

WHAT DO I NEED TO QUALIFY FOR THIS JOB?

 *  5+ years management experience of complex construction and plant building projects
 * Advanced knowledge of engineering and business-unit-related technologies to understand technical implications
 * Advanced knowledge of project management methods and tools, as well as knowledge of contract law and regulations relevant to project business
 * Work experience in international teams
 * Willingness to travel and site assignments
 * Advanced knowledge in English and German

Social Skills

 * Proactive, solution-oriented attitude
 * High integrity in dealing with others
 * Quality oriented and structured work approach
 * Strong leadership and communication skills
 * Distinctive conflict management skills
 * Intercultural skills

WHAT ELSE DO I NEED TO KNOW?

Interested?
